scripted: The sim's own rules, written by hand: hold back a defending squad, send a strike squad at the enemy carrier or the lead freighter, launch to keep a wing in space. It stays in the stable until learned commanders beat it.
c1_shaped: Learned overnight on 2026-11-08, rewarded a little whenever the balance of ships swung its way and for winning. It flies its own launches and carrier; about level with the script.
c1_shaped_s1: The same training as c1_shaped from another random start, to show how much two runs differ. About level with the script.
c1_outcome: Learned overnight on 2026-11-08 from wins and losses alone, with no reward along the way. About level with the script and with c1_shaped.
long_7149: Trained for about two days on 2026-11-21 to 23, starting from commander 3's best. It beats the script two games in three and edges the side that gives no orders, mostly by launching well and almost never giving an order: with today's pilots, an order costs a ship more than it gains.
